name: Tun Tahir
role: Seri Nara Diraja and treasury patron
bio: A receipt seeking the treasury’s recognition goes to Tahir’s circle. It does not bypass the temenggung’s ruling at customs.
traits: Distinguishes an account from a claim
notes: fact: Brown names Tahir among those killed in the purge and Hamzah as his surviving son; Cortesão’s note associates Tahir with the treasury (Brown chs. XXII–XXIII, pp. 163, 170; Pires II, p. 256 n. 1)
gameplay: Receipt referrals are fictional, and the treasury is not the customs bench (people-factions.md §2; port-labour.md §2)
